opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a path to financial freedom and passive Ethereum income while requiring payment for entry: registration involves purchasing matrix slots for 0.05 Ethereum, and the speaker says, "first slot in each program costs 0.025 ethereum you can buy separately they are bringing together upon registration so to register in for such you need 0.05 ethereum." Its income structure depends on referrals, positions, uplines, and further payments: "100% of the payments of your referrals go to your wallet," while receiving payments after reinvestment requires an upgrade. It presents activated slots as producing "income for life" and projects up to 613.35 Ethereum from X3 and 817 Ethereum from X4. The supplied evidence does not establish that these figures are achievable, guaranteed, independently verified, or actually paid.
